```{r Extended Data Figure 7e}
# create a metadata to denote fetal and postnatal OPC
OPC$Fetal.OPC <- case_when(
  OPC$Subtype %in% c("Early Fetal OPC", "Late Fetal OPC") & OPC$postnatal == "Fetal" ~ "Fetal OPC", OPC$Subtype == "Postnatal OPC" & OPC$postnatal == "Postnatal" ~ "Postnatal OPC", TRUE ~ "Other OPC")

OPC$Fetal.OPC <- factor(
  OPC$Fetal.OPC,
  levels = c("Fetal OPC", "Postnatal OPC", "Other OPC"))

DefaultAssay(OPC) <- "RNA"
Idents(OPC) <- "Fetal.OPC"

# calculate the DEG between Postnatal OPC and Fetal OPC
agg<-AggregateExpression(OPC,assays="RNA", return.seurat=F, group.by=c("sample_id","Fetal.OPC"))
pb <- agg$RNA
colnames(pb)<- gsub("-","_",colnames(pb))
meta <- OPC@meta.data[, c("Fetal.OPC","sample_id","dev.group","Sex","Race","postnatal")]

meta_unique <- meta[!duplicated(paste(meta$sample_id, meta$Fetal.OPC)), ]

meta_unique$colname <- paste(meta_unique$sample_id,
                             meta_unique$Fetal.OPC,
                             sep = "_") %>% gsub("-","_",.)
rownames(meta_unique) <- meta_unique$colname
rownames(meta_unique)[grep("10X",rownames(meta_unique))] <- paste0("g",rownames(meta_unique)[grep("10X",rownames(meta_unique))])
meta_unique <- meta_unique[colnames(pb), ]

cellcount<-table(OPC$Fetal.OPC,OPC$sample_id) %>% data.frame()
rownames(cellcount)<-paste(cellcount$Var2,cellcount$Var1,sep="_")
rownames(cellcount)[grep("10X", rownames(cellcount))] <- paste0("g",rownames(cellcount)[grep("10X", rownames(cellcount))]) 


meta_unique$CellCount<-cellcount[rownames(meta_unique),]$Freq

#check
all(rownames(meta_unique) == colnames(pb))

ct.1 <- "Postnatal OPC"
ct.2 <- "Fetal OPC"
keep <- (meta_unique$Fetal.OPC == ct.1 | meta_unique$Fetal.OPC == ct.2)

ct_counts <- pb[, keep]
ct_meta   <- meta_unique[keep, ]

ct_meta$dev.group <- factor(ct_meta$dev.group,
                            levels = c("Fetal","Infant","Child","Adolescent","Adult"))
ct_meta$Sex[is.na(ct_meta$Sex)] <- "NAFetal"
ct_meta$Sex <- factor(ct_meta$Sex)
ct_meta$Fetal.OPC <- factor(ct_meta$Fetal.OPC, levels = c(ct.2, ct.1))
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(ct_counts),
  colData = ct_meta,
  design = ~ Fetal.OPC
)

keep_genes <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep_genes, ]

dds <- DESeq(dds)
vsd <- vst(dds)

res <- results(dds, name="Fetal.OPC_Postnatal.OPC_vs_Fetal.OPC")
res <- lfcShrink(dds,
                 coef="Fetal.OPC_Postnatal.OPC_vs_Fetal.OPC",
                 res=res, type = "normal")
res.df<-res %>% data.frame


res_tbl <- res %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var="gene") %>%
  as_tibble()

# set thresholds
padj_cutoff <- 0.05
res_table_thres <- res_tbl %>% 
  mutate(threshold = padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1)

# set comparison direction
res_table_thres$direction <- ""
res_table_thres$direction[!is.na(sign(res_table_thres$log2FoldChange))] <- ifelse(sign(res_table_thres$log2FoldChange[!is.na(sign(res_table_thres$log2FoldChange))])==-1, yes = "down", no = "up")
res_table_thres$threshold[is.na(res_table_thres$threshold)]<-FALSE

Top_Hits <- head(arrange(res_table_thres, abs(log2FoldChange)), 10)
Top_Hits <- rbind(Top_Hits, head(arrange(res_table_thres[res_table_thres$log2FoldChange >=1,], desc(log2FoldChange)), 5))

# Create the 'label' column: gene name for top hits, NULL otherwise
res_table_thres$label <- if_else(res_table_thres$gene %in% Top_Hits$gene, res_table_thres$gene, as.character(NA))

# top hits DEG beteen Postnatal OPC and Fetal OPC volcano plot
ggplot(data=res_table_thres, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-1*log10(padj), color=threshold)) +geom_point(size=1) + scale_color_manual(values= c("black","red3")) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1,linetype = "dashed")+geom_vline(xintercept = -1,linetype = "dashed")+geom_hline(yintercept = -1*log10(0.05),linetype = "dashed")+theme_bw() + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
  aes(label = label),
  size = 3,        
  box.padding = 0.5,
  point.padding = 0.5,
  segment.color = 'grey50', 
  show.legend = FALSE,
  color="black"
)
```

```{r Ext Data Fig 7f}
adult <- readRDS("output/objects/adult_ref.RDS")

ref_OL <- subset(adult, cell_type=="oligodendrocyte")

ref_OL$Cell_Type <- "Ref_OL"

ref_OL <- ref_OL %>%
  NormalizeData() %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures=3000) %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  SCTransform(vars.to.regress = NULL)


ref_OL<-ref_OL %>% 
  RunPCA(assay = "SCT", npcs = 50) %>%
  RunHarmony(group.by.vars = c("sample_id"),
             reduction = "pca", assay.use = "SCT", reduction.save = "rna") %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "rna", assay = "SCT", dims = 1:50, 
          reduction.name = 'umap.rna', reduction.key = 'rnaUMAP_') %>%
  FindNeighbors() %>%
  FindClusters(verbose = TRUE)

# assign subtypees
DimPlot(ref_OL,group.by = "SCT_snn_res.0.8" )
DimPlot(ref_OL,group.by = "sample_id" )
DimPlot(ref_OL,group.by = "development_stage" )
FeaturePlot(ref_OL, features = c("MBP", "MOG", "MYRF", "NKX6-2",
                                 "RBFOX1", "OPALIN"), 
            coord.fixed = T,ncol=3)

VlnPlot(ref_OL, group.by = "SCT_snn_res.0.8",features = 
          c("MBP", "MOG", "MYRF", 
            "RBFOX1", "OPALIN", "NKX6-2"),
        pt.size = 0, layer="counts", ncol = 4)

clust_map<-c("0"= "RBFOX1 OL",
             "1"= "OPALIN OL",
             "2"= "RBFOX1 OL",
             "3"= "RBFOX1 OL",
             "4"= "OPALIN OL",
             "5"= "RBFOX1 OL",
             "6"= "RBFOX1 OL",
             "7"="RBFOX1 OL",
             "8"="RBFOX1 OL",
             "9"="RBFOX1 OL")
ref_OL$Subtype <-""
for (clust in names(clust_map)) {
  ref_OL$Subtype[ref_OL$SCT_snn_res.0.8 == clust] <- clust_map[clust]
}

OL_subtype_colors <-  c("Early OL" = "#3998f5","RBFOX1 OL" = "#8A2BE2","OPALIN OL" = "#1A3EAB")

ref_OL$Subtype <- factor(ref_OL$Subtype, names(OL_subtype_colors[2:3]))

DimPlot(ref_OL,group.by = "SCT_snn_res.0.8" )
DimPlot(ref_OL,group.by = "Subtype",cols = OL_subtype_colors) 
```
